behavior.text: when I click the ground, make everything float for 5 seconds and then drop a bunch of rainbow bricks

summary: When you click the ground: everything floats for 5 seconds
Then gravity comes back and a bunch of rainbow bricks fall from the sky
claude.notes: Gravity has to come back before the bricks drop, or they would float too. I dropped 14 bricks in rainbow colors at random spots near the middle. Clicking again while things are floating does nothing until the bricks have finished falling.
